title: Meta ties up with Ambani's Reliance for AI data center in India
title_zh: Meta 与 Ambani 的 Reliance 合作在印度建设人工智能数据中心
summary: June 10 (Reuters) - Facebook-parent Meta said on Wednesday that it has tied up with Indian billionaire Mukesh Ambani's Reliance Industries for an AI-enabled data center in India.
summary_zh: 6 月 10 日（路透社）——Facebook 母公司 Meta 周三表示，它已与印度亿万富翁穆克什·安巴尼 (Mukesh Ambani) 的信实工业 (Reliance Industries) 合作，在印度建立人工智能数据中心。

title: OpenAI weighs leasing Ohio data center with Nvidia backing, The Information reports
title_zh: 据 The Information 报道，OpenAI 考虑在 Nvidia 的支持下租赁俄亥俄州数据中心
summary: OpenAI is in talks to lease a proposed 10-gigawatt data center campus on federal ‌land in Ohio, in a deal that could ‌include financial backing from Nvidia, The Information reported on Tuesday, citing two ​people with direct knowledge of the discussions.
summary_zh: 据《The Information》周二援引两位直接了解相关讨论情况的人士的话报道，OpenAI 正在就在俄亥俄州联邦土地上租用一个拟议的 10 吉瓦数据中心园区进行谈判，该交易可能包括 Nvidia 的财务支持。

title: There's more 'adoption of options' among retail traders: Schwab
title_zh: 施瓦布：散户交易者更多地“采用期权”
summary: Retail investors are piling back into AI trade leaders, according to the latest Schwab Trading Activity Index (STAX) report.
summary_zh: 根据最新的施瓦布交易活动指数（STAX）报告，散户投资者正在涌入人工智能贸易领军企业。

title: Why Elon Musk's track record of unfilled promises matters for investors
title_zh: 为什么埃隆·马斯克未兑现承诺的记录对投资者很重要
summary: As Tesla (TSLA) CEO Elon Musk prepares to expand his corporate empire through SpaceX's IPO this Friday, June 12, should his promises and vision be met with a healthy dose of skepticism by investors?
summary_zh: 当特斯拉 (TSLA) 首席执行官埃隆·马斯克 (Elon Musk) 准备通过 SpaceX 于 6 月 12 日周五进行 IPO 来扩大他的企业帝国时，他的承诺和愿景是否会受到投资者的适当怀疑？

title: What massive SpaceX-Alphabet compute deal means ahead of IPO
title_zh: IPO 前 SpaceX 与 Alphabet 的大规模计算交易意味着什么
summary: SpaceX (SPAX.PVT) continues to turn investors' heads ahead of its IPO this Friday, June 12, as Elon Musk's space company strikes a deal with Alphabet (GOOG, GOOGL) for the Big Tech company to borrow computing power for $920 million per month.
summary_zh: SpaceX (SPAX.PVT) 在 6 月 12 日星期五首次公开募股 (IPO) 前继续吸引投资者的目光，埃隆·马斯克 (Elon Musk) 的太空公司与 Alphabet (GOOG、GOOGL) 达成协议，让这家大型科技公司每月以 9.2 亿美元的价格借用计算能力。

title: Tim Cook signs off his last WWDC
title_zh: 蒂姆·库克 (Tim Cook) 结束他最后一次 WWDC
summary: End of an era... Tim Cook’s LAST WWDC.
summary_zh: 一个时代的结束……蒂姆·库克的最后一次 WWDC。

title: Anthropic launches Mythos-class Claude Fable 5 model, available to the public
title_zh: Anthropic 推出 Mythos 级 Claude Fable 5 模型，向公众开放
summary: Anthropic has launched Claude Fable 5, its most powerful AI model yet.
summary_zh: Anthropic 推出了迄今为止最强大的人工智能模型 Claude Fable 5。

title: Apple is bringing a more 'mainstream' AI to its customers: Analyst
title_zh: 苹果正在为其客户带来更“主流”的人工智能：分析师
summary: Apple (AAPL) showcased its new AI-powered Siri (Siri AI) at its 2026 Worldwide Developers Conference (WWDC), a long-awaited entry into the AI race from the iPhone maker as it offers a more personal style of digital assistant.
summary_zh: 苹果 (AAPL) 在 2026 年全球开发者大会 (WWDC) 上展示了全新的人工智能驱动的 Siri (Siri AI)，这是这家 iPhone 制造商期待已久的人工智能竞赛，因为它提供了更加个性化的数字助理。

title: Wall Street sees AI trade bearing fruit with MANGOS ahead of IPOs
title_zh: 华尔街认为人工智能交易在首次公开募股前与 MANGOS 结出硕果
summary: MANGOS — no, not the tropical stone fruit — is the latest Big Tech acronym to be at the top of investors' minds ahead of 2026's biggest IPOs.
summary_zh: 在 2026 年最大规模的 IPO 之前，芒果（MANGOS）——不，不是热带核果——是投资者最关心的最新大型科技缩写词。
